The following events took place in '''15 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The adventures of [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], take place on several [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] across the [[The galaxy/Legends|Galaxy]].<ref name="A State of Nelvana">{{InsiderCite|73|A State of Nelvana: Droids & Ewoks Adventure Hour Revisited|A State of Nelvana: ''Droids & Ewoks Adventure Hour'' Revisited}}</ref><ref name="P170">{{PolyhedronCite|170|Star Wars Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO}}</ref><ref name="FBtB">{{SW|url=news/from-boonta-to-baobab-droids-and-the-star-wars-prequels|text=From Boonta to Baobab: ''Droids'' and the ''Star Wars'' Prequels|nolive=1}}</ref>
*[[Thall Joben/Legends|Thall Joben]] and [[Jord Dusat]] win the [[Boonta Speeder Race]], and and are offered to work at [[Zebulon Dak Speeder Corporation/Legends|Zebulon Dak Speeder Corporation]].<ref name="ARttF">{{DroidsCite|A Race to the Finish}}</ref>
*[[Tammuz-an/Legends|Tammuz-an]] [[Battle of Tammuz-an|became]] a united [[Planet/Legends|world]].<ref name="TPoT">{{DroidsCite|The Pirates of Tarnoonga}}</ref>
*The destruction of the [[Great Heep]].<ref name="TGH" />
*[[Umboo Racing Team]] win the [[Roon Colonial Games]].<ref name="TRG">{{DroidsCite|The Roon Games}}</ref>
*All but one known exception of the [[Roonstone]]s on [[Roon/Legends|Roon]] were destroyed.
*The [[Rego Mineral Company]] contacted [[Altor 14]].<ref name="GG4">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref>
*The [[Peace City|first]] of the [[Ylesia/Legends|Ylesian]] colonies was founded by [[Aruk Besadii Aora]] and [[Zavval]].<ref name="TPS">''[[The Paradise Snare]]''</ref>
*On [[Findris]], [[Earnst Kamiel]] and two others found the [[Justice Action Network]], a terrorist group that aims to destroy the infrastructure of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="GNN8" />
